[Pauta](https://pauta-project.dev/) is the set of guidelines Termina and its sibling apps follow, so they
look and work the same on Windows, macOS and Linux. Each rule has an ID and a level: a **MUST** is
required, a **SHOULD** is expected unless there is a stated reason.

Termina is built to **[Pauta 6.2.0](https://pauta-project.dev/6.2.0/)**.

**Pauta conformance: Core.** Termina meets every MUST of this edition; 1 SHOULD is pending.

| Conformance | Means |
|---|---|
| Complete | Every MUST and every SHOULD is met, does not apply, or is a recorded deviation. |
| Core | Every MUST is met; one or more SHOULDs are still pending. |
| Partial | One or more MUSTs are still pending. The app says *Working toward*, not *Built to*. |

The conformance is worked out from the list below, never typed in, so it cannot claim more than the list
shows. The same list is in the app: **Help → Pauta Conformance** opens it, and **About** names the edition
and the conformance.

![The Pauta Conformance window: the edition, the conformance, and the list of rules not met with the reason for each](/screenshots/docs/pauta.png "Help → Pauta Conformance, in the app.")

## Pending

Rules Termina does not meet yet. Each one links the issue that tracks it. 1 rule: 0 MUST, 1 SHOULD.

| Rule | Level | What is different | Link |
|---|---|---|---|
| <a href="https://pauta-project.dev/6.2.0/release/#rel-17" style="white-space: nowrap"><code>REL-17</code></a> | SHOULD | The Windows installer is not signed. | [#92](https://github.com/adriandeleon/Termina/issues/92) |

## Deviations

Recommendations Termina follows differently on purpose. Each one links the decision record that says why. 1 rule: 0 MUST, 1 SHOULD.

| Rule | Level | What is different | Link |
|---|---|---|---|
| <a href="https://pauta-project.dev/6.2.0/keyboard/#kbd-04" style="white-space: nowrap"><code>KBD-04</code></a> | SHOULD | On macOS the menu bar at the top of the screen is drawn by the system, which gives Termina no way to say why a greyed row cannot run; the Command Palette and every menu Termina draws do. | [Decision 0014](https://github.com/adriandeleon/Termina/blob/master/docs/decisions/0014-no-reason-on-a-greyed-row-of-the-macos-menu-bar.md) |
